description:
This two-bedroom, two bathroom furnished flat is to let within the Horizon development in central Bristol, offering practical, modern city living. Tenants have access to the communal garden, which can be seen from the balcony

Situated in Bristol’s BS1 area, the property is well placed for access to the Harbourside, Cabot Circus and the city centre, all offering a wide choice of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants. Brandon Hill Park and Castle Park are both within easy reach, providing green space for walking and leisure.

Public transport links are strong. Bristol Temple Meads station is approximately 15 minutes’ walk or a short bus ride away, with regular services to London Paddington in around 1 hour 40 minutes, as well as routes to Cardiff, Bath, Exeter and the wider South West and Midlands. Numerous local bus routes connect BS1 to Clifton, Redland, Southville and other parts of the city.
